closed_issue.body:
## Resolved — D41: accepted for experimental AMP generation

The investigator accepts the exact modern HydrAMP dev3 resource and documented deviations within the reviewed experimental AMP scope. [Published decision and evidence](https://github.com/uibcdf/peptidemt/issues/8#issuecomment-6619182159).

The work record is archived locally at `devguide/archive/qualify_hydramp_increment_2.md`; normative disposition: `devguide/hydramp_dev3_acceptance.md`. This closes the reviewed qualification/disposition through its explicitly accepted scope, retaining original FAILs and all scientific/provenance/use limits; it does not assert universal equivalence, biological efficacy, all historical H0–H4 gates or release readiness.

Future consumer work is [PeptideMT #32](https://github.com/uibcdf/peptidemt/issues/32), cross-linked to owned HydrAMP #3–#6. No new model execution, training, GPU, release or external-author contact is authorized. Scientific evidence and original SHAs/environments are unchanged. Documentation remains local/uncommitted.

## Original commission — retained history

Following D37 acceptance and completed increment-1 delivery (#6), prepare the next scientific commissioning decision within D33/D34: native learned generation with the proposed HydrAMP route, followed by the existing assessment/selection core.

This issue owns proposal/readiness review, not authorization to install, load or execute HydrAMP. D35/D36, M1–M8 and the exact accepted Macrel bundle remain unchanged. The existing H0–H4 proposal is in devguide/v0_1_increment_1.md; a focused readiness record will link it rather than reopen general architecture.

Read-only current-source inspection confirms official HydrAMP master 6590d2f4c2963f25d30669052a4c4a857e0e7279 and official starter main 7804df862872ccc6d09fe01c41bafbca194cfa31. Proposed route: softmax constructor, native unconstrained_generation(mode='amp', filter_out=False, n_attempts=1, properties=True), explicit seed and bounded positive n_target. Preserve native order, duplicates, scores/descriptors and the distinction between hidden token views and returned strings. Internal amp/mic are not Macrel scores, measured MIC or independent validation.

Preparation must resolve artifact-specific provenance/terms/hashes and the legacy isolated Python 3.8 stack without changing the Python 3.14 suite host or blindly adopting the starter's metadata overrides. Molecular operations remain MolSysMT-owned; use the suite responsibility map and existing support-library boundaries.

H0–H4 scientific approval, exact environment/artifact qualification, a fresh shared-host CPU/RAM/disk/time envelope, and a separate new Macrel execution budget must precede the relevant execution. The old four-call allowance is exhausted; no GPU, automatic refill/retry, analogue route, feedback, target-conditioned work or publication is inferred.

This review completes when investigators accept/narrow/decline the concrete next commission, with remaining prerequisites explicit and indexes/status documents consistent. The new documentation inventory handoff remains uibcdf/molsyssuite#156; do not reopen #151/#152.
